note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Fermanagh took place on Wednesday 3 June 1936 and the results were declared on Thursday 4 June. The Monea division was the only contest in this district. The other twenty-five divisions were filled unopposed at the nominations; their members are named in the Impartial Reporter of 7 May 1936, p. 7 (added 6 Nov 2026). Filed on 1936-06-03, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (provisional); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
